name: Sequential Chain 专用
description: 流水线串行处理场景，验证步骤间的数据传递和顺序执行

test_cases.question: Process this data step by step: (1) List the numbers 1 through 5, (2) Square each number, (3) Sum the results.

Step 1: Reverse the string 'abcdef'. Step 2: Convert to uppercase. Output the result.
